independence: Picked from the episode transcript, shot list and video keyframes only; no creator Shorts/Reels were opened or searched for.

coverage.note: Whole episode read in order. Excluded: 0:00-0:29 B2P logo + rain intro (no dialogue), 2:32-2:40 GIRLS HOSTEL title card, 12:17-13:08 song/riding montage, 14:16-15:11 song, 16:06-16:26 end credits.

notes: Girls Hostel 2.0 (B2P Studios) Ep1. CANDIDATE picks for the clip-judge filter (founder process 2026-10-07): proposed generously, every clip ends on a beat. Characters named from dialogue + frames: Akshara (Zomato delivery girl, pays her own coaching fees), Meenakshi (her close friend; pink kurta; secretly married), Ekta (roommate, curly hair; mediator with a selfish streak), rich roommate (unnamed in Ep1; pink lace top, has a car), Jai (Akshara's delivery-partner friend), the stalker (unnamed suitor), banquet-hall manager. Scribe speaker ids are unreliable here (one id covers whole scenes); speakers were assigned from content and frames. Option-2 cutting: time_segments are the cut (may include silent beats); pieces are the words inside them; edited_duration = word span sum; video_duration = segment sum.

clips.title: Swiggy bags పెట్టొద్దు… నా fees నేనే కట్టుకోవాలి | light లే
clips.why: Rich roommate: delivery bags in the room are 'insulting'. Akshara's dignified 'నా fees నేనే కట్టుకోవాలి', then Ekta's deadpan 'అదేమన్నా hostel fees కడుతుందా? light లే' caps it.
clips.payoff_line: అదేమన్నా hostel fees కడుతుందా? light లే
clips.notes: Opens on the rich roommate addressing Akshara by name (shot cut 171.9 falls 0.3 s after the first word). 'చూడే ఎక్తా నువ్వైనా చెప్పు దానికి' is the rich roommate (frame 198) asking Ekta to mediate; 'నువ్వు కూడా ఏంటి? ... light లే' is Ekta (frames 207-211, eating from a bowl) telling Akshara to let it go. 'light లే' = 'take it light'. Ends on the shot cut at 211.12 right after 'లే' (hold is only 0.2 s because the shot changes); Akshara's deflated 'సరేలే నేను చదువుకోవాలి' (211.6-214.4) left out as a weaker tail; the judge may prefer ending at 214.5 instead. Who says 'light లే' (0.3 s) is inferred from the two-shot; could be Akshara.

clips.title: నువ్వేమైనా పెద్ద officer అయిపోతావా? | ఏదో ఒకరోజు నువ్వే నమ్ముతావ్
clips.why: A parent's voice ('shut up and come work with me') over Akshara's face at night; she answers 'I'll pay for it myself, one day you'll believe in me'. Short, raw motivation beat.
clips.payoff_line: సరే నేనే ఏదో ఒకటి చేసుకుని కట్టుకుంటా. ఏదో ఒకరోజు నువ్వే నమ్ముతావ్.
clips.notes: This is NOT a visual flashback: frames 254-272 show only Akshara sitting alone on the rooftop, eyes closed, while the argument plays as voice-over (her memory). The parent's voice could be mother or father; I could not tell from frames. The shot cuts at 271.96 right on the last word (next shot is Meenakshi at the door), so there is no reaction hold available; 17.6 s is short. Payoff is a resolve line rather than a snap: payoff 3 by the judge's scale unless her face counts as the visible reaction.

clips.title: దానమ్మ బాబులు బలిసినోళ్లే… అందుకే దానికి అంత బలుపు
clips.why: Meenakshi finds Akshara crying alone, names the rich roommate's arrogance ('అందుకే దానికి అంత బలుపు') and lifts her; ends on Akshara wiping tears and smiling, both walk off.
clips.payoff_line: దానికే ఏదో ఒకరోజు తెలిసి వస్తుంది లేవే. / ఓకే నా పదా వెళ్దాం
clips.payoff_type: emotional peak with visible reaction (tears wiped, smile)
clips.notes: Continuous, no cuts; two 3 s silences inside (286-289, 302-305) kept. Frames 343-346: Akshara wipes her eyes and smiles; 347-350 both walk away. 'జయ్ ఏమన్నా అన్నాడా?' names Jai (her delivery friend) without explaining him: small inside reference. ASR: 'ఖచ్చితంగా ఆదనా ఏదో అని ఉంటుంది' is probably 'అది ఏదో అని ఉంటుంది' (she must have said something). 'నాకంటే పెద్ద problem ఉందా నీ life లో' foreshadows Meenakshi's own secret (end of episode) but reads fine without it.

clips.title: ప్రతి week ఇట్లానే చెప్తున్నావ్… | long distance romance
clips.why: Meenakshi nags her long-distance guy ('every week you say you're coming') and hangs up; roommates ask 'ఎవరే?' and she grins 'long distance romance', everyone giggles.
clips.payoff_line: నాకు ఎవరు చేస్తారే మీకు తెలియదా? long distance romance ఏయ్
clips.payoff_type: light punchline with a laugh beat
clips.notes: Starts on the shot cut 412.2 on Meenakshi's line 'ఈ week అయినా వస్తున్నావా ఇక్కడికి' (the man's 'హా తిన్నాను' just before is dropped; Scribe merged both into one sentence, so the start is inside sentence [527-540] but on a speaker/line boundary). The phone call is intercut with the man (frames 414-432). 'అంత చెప్తున్నా' (441.5) is unclear ASR (maybe 'అంతే చెప్తున్నా'); ends on the giggles and the shot cut at 444.6. The man is later revealed (16:03) to be, presumably, her husband; the clip gives nothing away. Mild payoff: the judge may call it 3.

clips.title: ఒక్కరోజు drop చేస్తే daily అలవాటు… | Rapido లో వెళ్లడం వంద రెట్లు best
clips.why: Nobody wants to give Meenakshi a lift: Ekta dodges ('one drop becomes a habit'); the rich roommate offers her car and Meenakshi refuses: 'Rapido is 100x better'. Second aside lands.

cut_reasons.1: 3 s of dead air between Ekta leaving and the rich roommate's line, cut on shot changes 536.7 / 539.7

clips.payoff_line: ఇది ఒక్కసారి drop చేస్తేనే ఊరంతా చెప్పుకొని తిరుగుతుంది ఏదో పెద్ద help చేసినట్టు. దీంతో వెళ్ళడం కంటే Rapido లో వెళ్లడం వంద రెట్లు best.
clips.payoff_type: comic aside voicing the inversion (refuses the only lift)
clips.notes: Speakers from frames: Meenakshi (pink kurta) asks Ekta (blue T-shirt, 519-526); Ekta's smirk aside at 526-534; the rich roommate (mirror, 540-550) offers the car; Meenakshi's aside 551-558 to camera-ish, looking down at 557-558. Ends on the shot cut 558.5 (hold after 'best' is 0.15 s). 'అరే మా friend వస్తానన్నది వే' is Ekta's excuse. One internal cut removing 3 s of silence.

clips.title: మీనాక్షిని ఎక్కించుకుంటే అదే petrol కొట్టించేది | plan worked
clips.why: Ekta's petrol runs out, she plans to pick up Meenakshi so Meenakshi pays; she arrives mid-stalker-fight, shoves him off, and the plan lands: 'పర్లేదులే నేను పట్టేస్తా' as they ride off.
clips.payoff_line: ఇక్కడికి వచ్చేసరికి petrol అయిపోయిందే / పర్లేదులే నేను పట్టేస్తా పదా
clips.payoff_type: setup pays off (the selfish plan works), reaction on scooter
clips.notes: Full scene, continuous, 81 s (above the typical 75 s). The stalker confrontation (628-664) is the middle; cutting it would break 'అంత cool గా చెప్తే వింటాడా వాడు'. Ekta's slap/shove at ~652 (frames 10:48-10:56). Opening line is an aside ('petrol just had to run out now'), not addressed to anyone: hook 3. Ends with both on the scooter after 'ఎక్కే' (677.6) at 679.5, before the ride montage. Overlaps w07 (same scene): the judge should keep at most one. ASR: 'వాడిని సావడం లేదే' ~ 'వాడికి సావడం లేదే'?, 'ఈసారి రా నీ వడి పని చెల్తా' = 'ఈసారి రానీ వాడి పని చెప్తా' (let him come again, I'll fix him).

clips.title: Rapido వన్నే అనుకో, నాకు డబ్బులు కూడా ఇయ్యి | stalker కి Ekta దెబ్బ
clips.why: Stalker offers Meenakshi a lift 'treat me as Rapido, even pay me', she tells him to get lost; Ekta arrives, shoves him off and exits on 'ఈసారి రానీ వాడి పని చెప్తా'.
clips.payoff_line: అంత cool గా చెప్తే వింటాడా వాడు … ఈసారి రానీ వాడి పని చెప్తా
clips.notes: Starts on shot cut 628.0 with the stalker's offer; ends on the shot cut 664.29 right after Ekta's exit line. 'నాకు డబ్బులు కూడా ఇయ్యి మాకు' - last word unclear. Ekta's shove is at ~652 (frames 10:48-10:56); 'ఏయ్ ఎన్నిసార్లు చెప్పాలిరా సిగ్గుగా లేదా' is Ekta. Shorter alternative to w06 (which contains it).

clips.title: లోపల IAS officers meeting… Shut up! Get out first
clips.why: Akshara walks a delivery into a banquet hall because nobody answered; the manager humiliates her ('Shut up, IAS officers inside, get out first'). Ends on her walking out alone.
clips.payoff_line: Don't talk, don't say what I have to do. Get out first
clips.notes: Starts at 830.4 on her 'sir, order' (after a 6 s music sting). Ends on 'Get out first' (856.5) plus a 5 s hold on the single wide shot of her walking out (857.4-861.5, no shot change until 866). The irony (an IAS aspirant thrown out of an IAS officers' meet) is not stated in the clip, so the payoff is a plain humiliation with a flat exit: likely payoff 3.

clips.title: ఒరేయ్ ఎదవా… నాకు already పెళ్లి అయింది
clips.why: Stalker: 'why do you ignore me however many times I propose?'. Meenakshi: 'I've told you a thousand times I don't like you'. 'But why?' - 'Idiot, I'm already married.' His face freezes.
clips.payoff_line: ఒరేయ్ ఎదవా నాకు already పెళ్లి అయింది
clips.payoff_type: reveal/twist with his stunned reaction on screen
clips.notes: Episode cliffhanger: SPOILER (Meenakshi is married). 20.6 s; ends on his stunned face held to the shot cut at 971.3 (credits follow). 'చెప్పక తప్పేలా లేదే' (959.7-963.3) was emitted by Scribe as an audio event, not words, so it is inside time_segments but not in pieces. Preceded by a 9 s music sting (940.8-949.6) so no earlier start; 'అబ్బా వీడు మళ్ళీ వచ్చాడండి' (939.1) could be prefixed with a cut across the sting if the judge wants the 'he came again' setup.

clips.title: Insta లో block చేసినట్టున్నావ్ | నాకున్న friends చాలు
clips.why: Stalker: 'did you think about what I said? I messaged on Instagram, you blocked me'. Meenakshi: 'who even gave you my ID? ... I have enough friends, I don't need new ones'.
clips.payoff_line: నాకున్న friends చాలు. కొత్త friends అవసరం లేదు.
clips.notes: First stalker encounter. Opens on Meenakshi's aside 'ఛీ వీడేంటి మళ్ళీ వచ్చాడు' (hook 3, not addressed to him). Ends on her line plus his face (593) and the shot cut 594.2. Payoff is a stance/rejection line: probably 3 on the judge's scale; proposed because it is the cleanest short beat of the stalker thread.

clips.title: 6KM extra వెళ్లి బిర్యానీ తెచ్చా… పోన్లే నాకోసం తెచ్చావ్
clips.why: Akshara walks in soaked with the roommate's biryani (6 km extra), gets no towel, and the thanks is 'I thought you wouldn't bring it... fine, you brought it for me'. Relatable roommate beat.

cut_reasons.1: 8 s of her taking off the raincoat (no dialogue) cut on shot changes 35.0 / 44.5
cut_reasons.2: 10 s of towelling off / silence cut on shot changes 48.0 / 58.3
cut_reasons.3: 7 s of silence while she changes cut on shot changes 67.0 / 74.5

clips.payoff_line: అదే వర్షం పడుతుంది కదా, తెస్తావో లేదోలే అనుకున్నా. పోన్లే నాకోసం తెచ్చావ్.
clips.notes: Three chunk cuts removing ~25 s of silent business; each lands on shot changes. The roommate here is the rich one (top bunk, pink lace top, frames 28-44 s). Soft payoff; proposed as a low-confidence relatable beat. 'ఓహ్ Sorry sorry' at 46.3 is the roommate's reply to the towel line.

clips.title: మరి classes? వెళ్తూ దారిలో వింటాలే… dedication
clips.why: A big order lands mid-meal; Akshara leaves her friend Jai to finish and will 'listen to class on the way'. Jai: 'dedication'. Her: 'తప్పదు కదా'.
clips.payoff_type: soft punchline with a laugh beat
clips.notes: Weakest candidate; included because it is the only Akshara-Jai beat and ends on a laugh event (724.8). Who says 'ఏంట్రా ఇంత పెద్ద order వచ్చింది' vs 'నేను వెళ్తాను' is assigned from context (Jai reads the order, Akshara leaves). Ends 0.7 s after 'తప్పదు కదా', before the goodbye lines.
